title: Acceptance within a fixed number of steps
statement: A finite oracle nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet accepts a Boolean input within $t$ steps, relative to an oracle language, if there is a sequence of exactly $t$ nondeterministic choice bits for which the run halts and its output is the one-symbol string consisting of true.
hypotheses_covered: A finite oracle nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
An oracle language over the Boolean alphabet
There exists a Boolean choice sequence of length exactly the step bound
The output is exactly the one-symbol string [true]
